question: In 2002, Zakir Hussain became the youngest percussionist to be honoured with which award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Bhushan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ustad Zakir Hussain is associated with the musical instrument, Tabla.
 
• He collaborated with the famous American band 'The Beatles' which deserves special mention.
 
• He was designated with awards:
 
 
• ​Padma Shri in 1988
 
• Padma Bhushan in 2002
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1990
 
• United States National Endowment for the Arts National Heritage Fellowship, the highest award given to traditional artists and musicians by the USA. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Albums of Ustad Zakir Hussain:

 
 
• ‘Saturday Night in Bombay’
 
• ‘The Believer’.
